description: Adds a fixed voltage to a signal, offsetting it up or down; a waveform running -5V to 5V becomes a 0-10V CV source when shifted by 5V

params.text: In the CLIP position the result is clamped to -5V and 5V, and in the NATURAL position it is passed at whatever voltage it reaches
Sets the voltage added to the input, -5V to +5V

inputs.text: Added to the SHIFT knob, and the total is what the input is offset by

outputs.text: The input plus the shift amount, clamped to -5V and 5V when the switch is set to CLIP

notes: With nothing patched into IN, OUT carries the shift amount alone, which makes the module a source of any fixed voltage between -5V and 5V.
